## What happened

Describe the observed behavior and what you expected.

## Reproduce

Include the smallest steps or command, Git revision, and relevant mission,
seed, controller/checkpoint, and settings.

## Environment and evidence

Include OS, browser or Node version, and backend if relevant. Paste the error
or attach a screenshot. For a research run, include completion status and the
available result or manifest; identify any missing local artifacts.
